name: neo4j-inspection
purpose: Optional reviewed, read-only graph inspection where Graphiti retrieval is insufficient.
capabilities: bounded read query when database privileges enforce it
setup_steps: Select, license-review, and pin one Neo4j MCP implementation
Use a database role with server-enforced read privileges
Verify its actual tool list and query restrictions against the intended database
health_check: MCP initialize and tools/list, followed by a separately approved harmless read only after permissions review
corrective_action: Review and pin the selected server, reference credentials locally, prove read-only behavior, and prevent Graphiti-managed writes from being bypassed.
permissions: Reviewed read-only Cypher only; database-side privileges must enforce the boundary.
